rules.title: SF annual allowable rent increase (Mar 2026–Feb 2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the maximum annual rent increase is 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.requirement_es: Para las unidades con control de rentas en San Francisco, el aumento anual máximo de la renta es de 1.6% entre el 1 de marzo de 2026 y el 28 de febrero de 2027.
rules.caveat: Rates page only; citation inferred (Rent Ordinance); coverage not described on this page. Rate is adjusted annually.

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate (Mar 2026–Feb 2027)
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay tenants interest on security deposits at 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios deben pagar a los inquilinos intereses sobre los depósitos de garantía a una tasa de 4.2% del 1 de marzo de 2026 al 28 de febrero de 2027.
rules.caveat: Rates page only; citation inferred; rate updated annually.

rules.title: SF relocation payments for owner move-in, demolition, capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For no-fault evictions (owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation) with notice served 3/1/26–2/28/27, the landlord owes $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled, or minor-child household member.
rules.requirement_es: En desalojos sin culpa (mudanza del propietario o familiar, demolición, mejoras de capital temporales o rehabilitación sustancial) notificados entre el 1/3/26 y el 28/2/27, el propietario debe pagar $8,245 por inquilino, hasta $24,733 por unidad, más $5,497 por cada inquilino mayor, discapacitado u hogar con menores.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: SF Ellis Act eviction relocation payments
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act evictions with notice served 3/1/26–2/28/27, the landlord owes $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.requirement_es: En desalojos bajo la Ley Ellis notificados entre el 1/3/26 y el 28/2/27, el propietario debe pagar $11,110.05 por inquilino, hasta $33,330.13 por unidad, más $7,443.90 por cada inquilino mayor (62+) o discapacitado.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.caveat: Rates table; amounts adjusted annually. Section cite from link label (37.9A).

rules.title: Relocation for temporary capital-improvement displacement under 20 days
rules.requirement: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code § 1947.9 rather than SF Rent Ordinance § 37.9C; SF lists the current rate as $446/day plus actual moving expenses.
rules.requirement_es: Los pagos de reubicación por desplazamiento temporal de menos de 20 días por mejoras de capital se rigen por el Código Civil de California § 1947.9 y no por la Ordenanza de Rentas § 37.9C; San Francisco indica la tarifa actual de $446 por día más gastos de mudanza.
rules.quoted_span: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.caveat: Only a passing mention of the state statute on a city rates page; the daily rate is listed by SF for 3/1/26–2/28/27.
